subject: Technical studio walkthrough — aligning SE, AE, and customer engineers
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmecloud.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Technical studio walkthrough — proposed scope and slots

Hi Alice / Maria,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to run a 60–75 minute technical studio walkthrough that demonstrates:
- End-to-end inference latency + cost profile on your sample workload
- Live deployment: private VPC demo and integration with your SSO
- KV/prefix caching and continuous batching effects with realistic request shapes
- Ops runbook and failover (what happens if a node is preempted)

We need AE + SE + a pair of your engineers (infra + security) and ideally a procurement touchpoint to cover contractual/PO questions. Proposed windows next week (all PST):
- Tue 16 Feb, 09:00–10:15
- Tue 16 Feb, 13:00–14:15
- Wed 17 Feb, 11:00–12:15

I've attached a short agenda and our technical factsheet. Marcus, can you confirm what we need from Acme for lab access (SSH keys, test account, sample dataset)? Evelyn, could you help route procurement if we need an LOE/PO discussion during the call?

Next steps: please reply with attendee names for the engineer seats and preferred slot.

Cheers,
Karthik
Principal AE, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: demo-studio-agenda-v2.docx, redwood-technical-factsheet.pdf
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmecloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmecloud.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, infra@acmecloud.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical studio walkthrough — proposed scope and slots

Hi Karthik,

Thanks — that scope looks good. Confirming participants on our side:
- Alice Jenkins (platform lead) — will join all tech sections
- Samuel Park (infra engineer) <sam.park@acmecloud.com> — to cover VPC/SSH/access
- Priya Raman (security) <security@acmecloud.com> — InfoSec will likely want to review SOC2 documentation ahead of the demo
- Procurement (procurement@acmecloud.com) — I'll loop them in for PO timeline but they won't join live unless needed

Preferred slot: Tue 16 Feb, 13:00–14:15 PST. If possible please allow 10–15 minutes at the end for procurement and licensing clarifications.

Maria
Senior Platform PM, AcmeCloud

Hey all — great, Tue 16 13:00 PST works for me. Quick note on prerequisites: 
- We need a short-lived test account in your staging VPC with a single VM that allows outbound to our demo host (we'll provide IPs).
- Public key for SSH access (sam.park or infra team can drop it in); if that's not possible we can do a web-based tunnel but that adds 10–15 mins to setup.
- For the SSO/SAML flow demo, we only need a test SP metadata file and one test user (no PII).

I can prepare two short test payloads (low and high concurrency) and the orchestration plan. I'll also attach a one-page runbook to the invite.

Marcus
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-runbook-onepage.pdf (stub)

Hi Maria / procurement team — looping in Ben from our Security & Compliance team and Marcus (SE). For the procurement ask: if Acme needs an LOE estimate or temporary MSA language to circulate internally before the demo, we can provide a concise note. Typical approach is to share an estimated cost range and clarify that any live proof-of-concept will have a short trial agreement (30 days) with limited usage caps.

Ben — can you share the standard SOC2 summary and any quick pointers we should send to Acme InfoSec before Tuesday? If the customer wants to review evidence, we can attach the SOC2 summary and a short checklist of operational controls.

Evelyn
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Hi Maria / Acme InfoSec,

Attaching our SOC2 summary and a short controls checklist. High level:
- SOC2 Type II (in scope: security, availability) — last audited Q4 2026
- Our standard encryption, KMS integration, and key rotation cadence included
- Audit log retention and customer audit process described in the checklist

If you want a short sync with our security lead (30 mins) before the demo we can arrange it Tue morning. Marcus / Evelyn, confirmed we can share the summary PDF (pdf attached).

Best,
Ben Carter
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
